description: This file provides comprehensive error handling utilities for a FastAPI-based backend, including error models, exception classes, centralized error handlers, in-memory rate limiting, and HTTP retry/backoff helpers.

classes.name: ErrorCode
classes.description: Enum class defining standardized error codes for API responses.

classes.name: ErrorDetail
classes.description: Model class capturing detailed error information, such as specific fields and messages.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Model class defining the standard structure of error responses returned by the API.

classes.name: AppError
classes.description: Base class for application-specific exceptions, including HTTP status and error code mappings.

classes.name: ValidationAppError
classes.description: Subclass of AppError for validation-related errors.

classes.name: UnauthorizedError
classes.description: Subclass of AppError representing HTTP 401 Unauthorized errors.

classes.name: ForbiddenError
classes.description: Subclass of AppError representing HTTP 403 Forbidden errors.

classes.name: NotFoundError
classes.description: Subclass of AppError representing HTTP 404 Not Found errors.

classes.name: ConflictError
classes.description: Subclass of AppError representing HTTP 409 Conflict errors.

classes.name: RateLimitExceeded
classes.description: Subclass of AppError indicating rate limiting, with optional retry-after information.

classes.name: ProviderError
classes.description: Subclass of AppError for upstream or provider call failures.

classes.name: _Bucket
classes.description: Internal data structure for in-memory rate limiting buckets.

methods.name: None register_exception_handlers(app: FastAPI)
methods.description: Sets up global exception handlers in FastAPI for custom and standard exceptions, providing consistent API error responses.

methods.name: None rate_limit_check(*, tenant_id: str, provider: str, route: str, capacity: int = 60, window_seconds: int = 60)
methods.description: Checks and enforces a simple fixed-window in-memory rate limit per (tenant, provider, route).

methods.name: T async_retry( func: Callable[[], T | Any], *, retries: int = 3, base_delay: float = 0.5, max_delay: float = 4.0, retry_on_status: tuple[int, ...] = (429, 500, 502, 503, 504), retry_on_exceptions: tuple[type[BaseException], ...] = (httpx.ConnectError, httpx.ReadTimeout, httpx.RemoteProtocolError, httpx.ConnectTimeout), )
methods.description: Retries an asynchronous operation with exponential backoff, handling certain HTTP status codes and exceptions.

methods.name: httpx.Response httpx_post_with_retry( url: str, *, client: Optional[httpx.AsyncClient] = None, **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST with auto-retry on transient errors, with support for custom clients.

methods.name: httpx.Response httpx_get_with_retry( url: str, *, client: Optional[httpx.AsyncClient] = None, **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET with auto-retry on transient errors, with support for custom clients.
